modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory activities for mixing paint with shades

pcs.pc_description: Use suitable ppe like rubber hand gloves and nose mask as required.
Ensure the place/room is clean, ventilated and well lit.
Select suitable colour ingredients based on hue and tone of shade required.
Transfer suitable amount of colours in a clean bowl.
Dissolve colours in suitable glue (fevicol).
Mix the ingredients (colours and glue) well with an stirrer or suitable paint brush.
Check the colour mixture by sample testing on waste paper or suitable materials to ensure it matches with the shade needed.
Ensure the object is clean and free from dust, dirt etc.
Ensure the object is not damp or wet.
Paint the object uniformly as per shade required.
Apply varnish on the product in order to get proper shine and make sure that color doesnt fade away.
Allow it to dry.
Keep the material in open atmosphere under shade.
Leave for 24-48 hrs.
Cover the product with thin strips of butter paper to absorb extra unfixed paints from surface.
Remove paper safely and slowly without damaging the paint.
Ensure painting is done with proper balance of colours as required for the object.

modules.module_title: Applying paints and varnish to object

pcs.pc_description: Select suitable brush size. usually 1 or 2 inch brush is common.
Identify the portion as main colour and a star.
Do brushing as per shade and precaution needed.
The process is continued till desired level of coating is attained.
Do the varnishing where needed.
Keep the material in open atmosphere under shade.
Leave it to dry.
Check to ensure no line or design mark is visible (should be covered up by paint colours).
Check the objects matches with design as per customer requirements for shade and motif.
